qualifications: The all-case goal remains open. Latest complete sweep measured 1,408 passes, 675 skips, 2,529 failures, 115 timeouts, and no crashes across 4,727. Focused results do not establish a new full-suite total.

Promise watchers use the same native kernel registration and handle lifetime as callback watchers. A private VM-heap FIFO retains event records and pending promise resolvers. Rust owns option validation, ignore matching, overflow, cancellation and closure; thin checked facades supply existing language async-generator delegation.

Captured Promise and array intrinsics prevent guest overrides from changing private queue operations. Abort cancellation uses the existing propagation-resistant event-target option and preserves original causes and tested error descriptors. Full constructor/subclass reflection and broader scheduling interactions remain open.

OXC is the syntax authority for CJS export names. Direct plain assignments and Node-compatible object literal lexical prefixes are collected without evaluating source or enumerating runtime exports. Comments, strings, compound/logical assignments are excluded. Generated wrappers expose the Node module.exports alias and quoted names.

Shared runtime namespace enumeration sorts string keys by UTF-16 code units without ordinary object array-index priority. Symbols follow strings. The new specialized/unspecialized regression also verifies ordinary object ordering remains unchanged; the active-program and call-root guard invariant is preserved.

Full CJS reexport/Object.defineProperty recognition, file-URL dynamic imports, complete watcher/private binding metadata, advanced globs, callback removal options/retry, ordinary stat decorators, and major transport/IPC/Worker/HTTP2 gaps remain open.
Checks and fixture groups ran sequentially, without overlapping compilation or extra guest probes. Frozen sibling binaries retain exact source and hashes; unrelated user edits are preserved.

All eight fixed-work fixtures and Richards are one-round iteration diagnostics. No matched production qualification or speed claim. Hardware PMU counters remain unavailable; no substitutes. Empty-script samples retain actual wait4 RSS and alternating order.
